title: Microtek UPS SEBz 900VA 1280- Watt Sinewave Inverter (White/Ivory)
description: Description, Microtek UPS SEBz 900VA is a pure sinewave UPS suitable for running load up to 720 watts. Built with micro controller based intelligent control design and pure sinewave output. It does not create any humming noise from inductive load such as fans and it supports wide range of batteries from 100 AH to 180 AH. Rated capacity 900 VA / 12V, output power 720 watts, battery 1 battery system (12 VDC), wave form sinewave, warranty 2 years. Key Features: Micro controller based intelligent control design. LED display indications (status and fault). CCCV technology with Auto Trickle Mode. Smart overload sense and short circuit protection. Battery state monitoring. Multi stage battery charger. Mains input voltage range slide selection switch.
Name: Microtek UPS SEBz 900VA 1280- Watt Sinewave Inverter (White/Ivory)
